Messages.Author: Simon Klibisch
Messages.Body:
Hi!
I just wanted to know whether the enhanced damage (by Mass Reality) is of
the same damage type as the weapon (e.g. Flamethrower). So a Flamethrower
would do 4R aggravated (with a superior Mass Reality), or is 2R aggravated
plus 2R normal right?
Thanks in advance,
Simon

Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:



The correct answer is your first option. There are other cards, for
example Manstopper Rounds, that add to a weapons damage and any
inherited effects also apply to the added damage, so a superior Mass
Reality sends of a sizzling 4R aggravated at the opposing minion.

Archibald Zimonyi
Malkavian Prince of Gothenburg

Yeah, but with mass reality, who needs to do agg? .44 does 2R with a
